title: The committed bootstrap no longer routes every task through a lane
summary: The block ia host --commit writes says reading, building, testing, editing and submitting a change need no binding, plugin, door or private access, routes through the lanes only when a task needs a method, and says an operation that needs a bound method or private authority refuses alone. It ends with a one-line ia-bootstrap marker, and names CONTRIBUTING.md when the repository has a plain file of that name; a directory, link or oversized file there never fails the command. A block written by the earlier text is updated in place, keeping its closing line break (CRLF, LF or none).
